title: Choose the Savyy project-page structure
question: Each direction treats Savyy as the evidence of a complete solo build. Choose how that evidence should unfold.

options.label: One Product, All the Way Through
options.lineage: a founder's thesis pinned above the complete production record
options.thesis: One serious product says more about my work than a shelf of tutorial builds, and Savyy carries the proof.
options.viewport: A large founder statement occupies the left half while an overlapping web-and-mobile Savyy specimen fills the right; a narrow proof register immediately names solo full-stack ownership, 4,000+ supported banks, and web, iOS, and Android delivery.
options.risk: The statement can feel self-congratulatory unless real product evidence enters the first viewport at equal scale.

options.label: The Founder's Build Ledger
options.lineage: a numbered construction record from financial problem to shipped product
options.thesis: Savyy unfolds as the record of one person taking a financial product from first constraint to daily operation.
options.viewport: A compact Savyy title and founder note open beside a vertical build index; the first three entries, banking connectivity, private categorization, and multi-platform delivery, begin as oversized ledger rows with screenshots clipped into the record.
options.risk: A chronological structure can hide the product's present usefulness if early construction notes dominate the opening.

options.label: Savyy in the Hands
options.lineage: a product journey with the engineering exposed beneath each interaction
options.thesis: The case follows what someone does with Savyy, then opens each moment to show the systems I built underneath it.
options.viewport: A wide web dashboard and a tall mobile screen share the fold; a numbered path moves from connecting a bank to understanding spending, while founder annotations expose Bridge, shared data, privacy controls, and native capabilities.
options.risk: The experience-first sequence can understate the breadth of solo engineering until the technical layer is opened.
